exposure: Racial/ethnic identification (Non-Hispanic Black, Hispanic, Non-Hispanic White)
outcome: Exclusively breast milk feeding (EBMF) at hospital discharge
cohort: The cohort consisted of mothers who intended to exclusively breast milk feed and their term newborns delivered at a single academic medical center in 2022.
finding: Non-Hispanic Black and Hispanic mothers were significantly less likely to exclusively breast milk feed at hospital discharge compared to non-Hispanic White mothers, despite all intending to do so.
mod_finding: Cesarean birth was associated with a decreased likelihood of exclusively breast milk feeding.
